items.title: Stanser all trafikk på T-bane og trikk mandag i protest
items.excerpt: I det rushtrafikken starter mandag vil T-baner og trikker i Oslo stoppe i 15 minutter i en politisk streik for Posten.

items.title: Sperrer av stoppet etter kampslutt. Folk strømmer ut av stadion: – Sikkerhetstiltak
items.excerpt: Alle som har kommet seg opp, må også komme seg hjem.

items.title: Solbakken reagerer på «urettferdig» Haaland-dekning: – Det er galimatias
items.excerpt: Erling Braut Haaland åpnet for første gang opp om situasjonen i Manchester City. Samtidig mener Ståle Solbakken at spissen brukes for mye i dekningen av saken.

items.title: Nusa herjet for Norge: «Driblet bort halve Wales»
items.excerpt: Norge tok en livsviktig seier mot Wales på Ullevaal. Her er NRKs vurdering av de norske spillerne.

items.title: US Transport chief says unclear if 'incompetence' or bad tech to blame for groundings
items.excerpt: Air carriers in the US canceled some 16,000 flights over the past 24 hours in the biggest such grounding since 9/11. Officials hinted that incompetence or faulty equipment, not malfeasance, is the cause.

items.title: Adames beats Welshman Warburton by unanimous decision
items.excerpt: WBC middleweight champion Carlos Adames beats Gerome Warburton by unanimous decision in a non-title super middleweight bout.

items.title: Fact check: 'Iranian' content farms reach millions
items.excerpt: Several social media accounts claiming to represent the Iranian military show signs of being part of so-called content farms. DW Fact Check looks at how they operate and how users can spot them.

items.title: 'Miracle on Mississippi' - All passengers rescued after New Orleans cruise ship collision
items.excerpt: The collision leaves 32 people in hospital with non-critical injuries, but no-one unaccounted for.

items.title: Spain test will reveal if Tuchel and England have learned World Cup lessons
items.excerpt: England's game with world champions Spain will reveal if head coach Thomas Tuchel has learned from summer disappointment, says chief football writer Phil McNulty.

items.title: India’s Assam state demolishes homes of 132 Muslim families
items.excerpt: Authorities in India’s Assam have demolished the homes of 132 Muslim families.
